claim.claim-text: 1. An automated manufacturing system (300) for constructing an engineered textile (132) from a workpiece (132') composed of superposed wires (140, 142), the manufacturing system (300) comprising:

2. The manufacturing system of claim 1, wherein the processing head (310) includes a stitching head (310) with a thread feeder (316) and a sewing needle (320) cooperatively configured to generate stitches.

3. The manufacturing system of claim 2, wherein the stitching head (310) further includes a needle receiver (322) operable to reciprocally translate the sewing needle (320), a bobbin case (318) operable to feed a bobbin thread, and a shuttle hook (328) operable to create a lockstitch between the bobbin thread and a top thread fed from the thread feeder (316).

4. The manufacturing system of any one of claims 1 to 3, further comprising an image capture device (330) configured to capture the image of the workpiece (132') and output data indicative thereof to the system controller (304).

5. The manufacturing system of any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the system controller (304) is further programmed to determine path plan data for moving the processing head (310) to join the superposed wires (140, 142) at the joint locations, the path plan data including an origin, a destination, and a joint route for traversing the processing head (310) from the origin to the destination.
6. The manufacturing system of any one of claims 1 to 5, further comprising a workpiece frame (200) configured to retain the superposed wires (140, 142) in a tensioned, crisscrossed pattern.

7. The manufacturing system of claim 6, wherein the workpiece frame (200) includes a plurality of adjoining casing walls defining an inner frame space across which the workpiece (132') is stretched, and a series of posts projecting from the casing walls and spaced from one another along the perimeter of the inner frame space, the wires being wound around the posts.

8. The manufacturing system of any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein the system controller (304) is further programmed to determine, one-at-a-time in real-time from the received sensor signals and the captured image of the workpiece (132'), the respective next adjacent one of the joint locations closest to each of the real-time positions of the stitching head (310).
9. The manufacturing system of any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the movable end effector (302) includes a support frame (306) attached to a robot arm (308).
10. The manufacturing system of any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the movable end effector (302) includes a support carriage attached to a slide track frame.

11. The manufacturing system of any one of claims 1 to 10, wherein the position sensor (332) includes one or more optical position sensors (332) mounted at discrete locations of a manufacturing cell (302) and operable to determine the real-time positions of the stitching head (310) relative to a calibrated origin position.

12. The manufacturing system of claim 11, wherein the system controller (304) is further programmed to calibrate the origin position and identify respective start locations of the stitching head (310) and the workpiece (132') relative to the calibrated origin position.
13. The manufacturing system of claim 4, wherein the image capture device (330) includes a high-precision digital camera carried by the processing head (310).
14. A method of operating an automated manufacturing system (300), the method comprising:
